messages:
Maria (CS): @Raj quick check-in for Galecrest private deploy — week0. Customer hit two blockers in their preflight: KMS decrypt failing during CI test, and intermittent 403s from our audit-log forwarder. Go-live target is next Tue. Can infra + network pair on this today? /cc @Olivia (Network) @Tobias (SRE)

Raj (Infra): On it. Maria, can you paste the exact KMS error they saw and the command they ran? Sounds like an IAM/principal mapping issue.

Maria (CS): Pasting what they sent (sanitized):
```
ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/galecrest-ci is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01
Command: aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01 --profile galecrest-ci
```
They say the role is their CI runner; they ran from their CI job.

Olivia (Network): That points to the policy not granting the cross-account CI principal permissions. Also check the key's key policy vs IAM policy — if key policy is restrictive, IAM grants may be ignored. @Raj did we include a trust for cross-account roles in the provisioning template?

Raj (Infra): I checked the terraform template — we have a `redwood-service` principal in place, but not the customer's `galecrest-ci` role. Will prepare a small patch to add the principal to the key policy and an inline grant for `kms:Decrypt` in staging. ETA ~30m.

Tobias (SRE): On the log side, we've been seeing spikes of 403s from the fluentd forwarder to our log-sink over the last 2 hours. It looks like token expiry / signature mismatch from their side intermittently. I queued failed batches; I can replay once policy issues are resolved. Also will bump the ingest quota temporarily to avoid backpressure while we triage.

Maria (CS): Customer flagged retention proof as part of compliance: they need signed statement and evidence of 90d audit log retention and KMS rotation history. Renewal team flagged as moderate risk until we can provide evidence.

Raj (Infra): Patch deployed to staging at 1758004360 (deploy job id infra-policy-patch-1758004360). Diff summary: `+ Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/galecrest-ci` added to key policy; added `kms:Decrypt` to inline grants for the connector role.

DeployBot: Deploy succeeded: infra-policy-patch-1758004360 -> staging

Tobias (SRE): I replayed queued logs after the staging patch; ingest healthy, error rate fell from ~12% -> 1.8%. Still watching for any 403 regression. I'll set a short alert for >5% 403 rate over 5m.

Olivia (Network): I also validated egress rules — asked customer to run from their bastion: `curl -v https://logs.redwood-infer.com/healthz` and `nc -zv logs.redwood-infer.com 443`. They ran both, tests passed. Sent the run outputs to Maria.

Maria (CS): Thanks. I've shared the decrypted test command and asked them to re-run their CI job to confirm. I'll also attach our retention SLA + rotation logs to the renewal packet once you confirm retention metadata exists.

Raj (Infra): Confirmed retention metadata: our audit store shows 92 days for their tenant (expected 90). I will export a signed snapshot of the retention ACL and rotation events for the last 6 months and drop into the support ticket.

Tobias (SRE): Alert rule added: `audit-forwarder-403-percent > 5% for 5m` -> paging on call. Also added a small dashboard tile to the customer's console showing recent 403 counts and KMS decrypt success rate.

Olivia (Network): Small note — their NAT gateway has a dynamic egress IP list; recommend we ask them to reserve a static egress IP for long-term reliability; noted in the runbook.

Maria (CS): Action items for handoff / renewal pack: 1) KMS policy updated & confirmation of decrypt test; 2) export rotation history + retention proof (Raj); 3) audit-forwarder alert + dashboard (Tobias); 4) runbook note on static egress (Olivia). I'll schedule a 2pm PT check-in to confirm go/no-go.

Raj (Infra): I'll draft a 5-line blameless preflight summary after the monitoring window and attach the policy diff.

Tobias (SRE): Monitoring window complete — 2h. 403s under threshold, no further replays needed.

Maria (CS): Customer re-ran CI; decrypt test passed. They also confirmed audit logs arrived for the last 24h after replay. Closing blockers and marking week0 as on-track. I'll upload the short summary to the renewal packet and flag risk -> low. Thanks team! :thumbsup: :party_parrot:

DeployBot: Reminder: scheduled rotation job at 2026-07-01 02:00 UTC
